rules.statement: PARA_ADDR_W (default 32, legal range 16 to 32) shall set the width of both i_apb_paddr and o_tlul_a_address.
PARA_SRC_W (default 8, legal range 1 to 8) shall set the width of o_tlul_a_source and i_tlul_d_source.
PARA_SRC_ID shall fit in PARA_SRC_W bits, i.e. lie in the range 0 to 2^PARA_SRC_W - 1.
The value of o_tlul_a_source on every request and the expected i_tlul_d_source shall equal PARA_SRC_ID (default 0).
o_tlul_a_user shall have width PARA_A_USER_W (default 1, range 1 to 32) and its bits shall always be driven to zero.
PARA_D_SINK_W (default 1, range 1 to 4) shall set the width of i_tlul_d_sink, which has no behavioral effect.
PARA_D_USER_W (default 1, range 1 to 32) shall set the width of i_tlul_d_user, which has no behavioral effect.
m_tlul_if shall use fixed non-overridable constants LPARA_A_SIZE = 2, LPARA_A_MASK = 4'b1111 and LPARA_D_ACK_DATA = 1 (AccessAckData d_opcode).

rules.condition: An illegal parameter value is used
rules.statement: An illegal parameter value shall be reported at elaboration of the verification source set.

rules.condition: An illegal parameter value is used
rules.statement: An illegal parameter value shall not be silently clamped.
